'''''The Panada's Kiss''''' was a modified [[YT-1760 small transport/Legends|YT-1760 small transport]] that was used by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Gern Zott]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Krol-Pek]] hired Zott to transport the fugitive [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Salld Nrump]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] to the nearby world [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], and Zott docked ''The Panada's Kiss'' in [[hangar 12C]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Varna Biqua]] on Genarius, to await Nrump's arrival. However, Nrump was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] by a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a team of freelance agents that were investigating Nrump's demise, arrived at the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay and negotiated with Zott to be transported to Cularin aboard the ''Kiss'' in place of the Sullustan. The mercenaries arrived in the bay shortly afterward and opened fire on ''The Panada's Kiss'', so Zott powered up the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and fled Genarius, and he subsequently transported the agents to Cularin.
